source_summary: A vertical Chinese landscape with misty layered mountains above a lakeside garden estate, tree-lined banks, pavilions, pines, rocks, water, bridges, and small scholar figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif selections.

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_massif
motifs.description: The large rounded mountain mass on the upper left, isolated from the margin inscriptions and seals, including its descending slopes and mist-softened lower edge.
must_preserve: fine parallel contour strokes following the mountain curvature
dark clustered vegetation dots along ridgelines
pale olive-brown wash gradients on the slopes
soft fog boundary at the mountain base

motifs.name: central_rounded_mist_ridge
motifs.description: The central mid-distance rounded ridge and saddle emerging from mist, with a darker crest and faint distant hills behind it.
must_preserve: thin layered contour linework across the rounded peak
dark stippled brush clusters along the crest
light translucent wash on the ridge flanks
soft atmospheric fading into the surrounding mist

motifs.name: right_layered_hillside
motifs.description: The right-side mid-distance hillside with overlapping rounded ridges, scattered tree clusters, and faint mountains receding behind it, cropped before the far-right seal area.
must_preserve: overlapping hill silhouettes
fine hairline texture strokes on the slopes
small dark tree dots and upright grove marks
pale mist gaps separating the hill layers

motifs.name: middle_willow_riverbank
motifs.description: The horizontal middle riverbank with low rounded hills, leafless and willow-like trees, small shrubs, and pale water channels running behind the garden area.
must_preserve: delicate bare-branch linework
soft green willow washes
small pink blossom accents
low hill texture strokes and shrub dots
thin pale water lines and open misty spacing

motifs.name: right_estate_roof_complex
motifs.description: The main right-side lakeside estate complex: nested halls, long grey tiled roofs, courtyard walls, windows, and trees partly screening the architecture.
must_preserve: precise grey roof geometry with upturned eaves
dense parallel roof-tile hatch lines
red, blue, and ochre architectural color accents
rectangular window and door grids
tree foliage and trunks overlapping the buildings where visible

motifs.name: foreground_red_pavilion_pines
motifs.description: The foreground red-pillared pavilion and its immediate garden setting, including the dark tiled roof, steps, nearby rocks, and pine branches crossing around it.
must_preserve: red column structure and railing details
dark grey roof with upturned corners and tile lines
small stairways and pale stone platform
gnarled pine limbs and clustered needle tufts
garden rocks with textured outlines

motifs.name: right_wooden_bridge_water
motifs.description: The arched wooden bridge on the lower right spanning pale water, with railings, posts, nearby banks, reeds, rocks, and flanking trees.
must_preserve: brown bridge rail geometry and vertical supports
arched deck line over the water
pale water wash and empty reflective space
reed and grass strokes along the banks
small rock textures and surrounding shrub foliage

motifs.name: lower_left_scholar_bridge
motifs.description: The lower-left wooden footbridge with two small robed figures crossing, adjacent banks, rocks, and overhanging foreground trees.
must_preserve: tiny scholar figures with colored robes and dark headwear
wooden bridge planks, railings, and posts
curving pale path leading onto the bridge
nearby rock outlines and bank textures
fine foreground tree branches and soft green foliage washes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
